relationships.subject: small fiber neuropathy
relationships.evidence_quote: We identified higher systemic gene expression of IL-2, IL-8, and TNF in SFN patients than in controls

relationships.subject: IL-2
relationships.evidence_quote: We further found a negative correlation between the relative gene expression of IL-2 and current pain intensity

key_findings: WBC gene expression of IL-2, IL-8 and TNF was higher in SFN patients than controls; combined AUC 0.81
Serum protein levels of IL-8 and TNF did not differ between groups
